title: Reword Plexus and Call Criteria pages to duration framing
description: The Plexus solution page and the Call Criteria case describe the engagement in present tense. Reword both to duration and cumulative framing (years in production, models managed, interactions processed) so every claim is checkable and stays true over time. Also update the two-years wording in AGENTS.md Strategic Marketing Terminology. Small copy change; no new content.

comments.text: Content review 2026-10 picks this up. Remaining fixed-fact violations found: about.js Key Facts says 'production platforms operated for 14+ years' and 'Call Criteria in production with RLHF for two years', and the FAQ repeats 'for two years'; AGENTS.md Strategic Marketing Terminology still says 'two years' three times; solutions/Venue-Driver.mdx excerpt says 'for 16 years'; solutions/Plexus.mdx is present tense ('Plexus powers the AI/ML lab at Call Criteria') and carries an unverifiable 'SOC 2 Type II certified' bullet.
